options: "Where is the LORD's word? Let it be fulfilled now."
"Who made you a prophet over us?"
"Why do you weep for this city?"
"When will the king of Babylon come?"

questions.q: Why does the LORD search the mind and try the heart?
options: To give each man according to his ways
To choose a new king for Judah
To find a prophet to send
To see who keeps the feasts

options: Their altars and their Asherah poles

wrong: so is my word in yours
so is the land before me
so will I shape the nations

We will return and serve the LORD
Let the priests decide for us

Only the vessels of the temple

Send an angel to defend the city

Baruch the son of Neriah, the scribe

That he would return from Babylon
That he was a faithful servant
That his sons would rebuild Jerusalem

It would be turned into a temple
It would be rebuilt even larger

Plant them in their own land

Building a great house for his name
Learning every word of the law

wrong: I will do as I please

The merchants who rob the poor

wrong: a sword that cuts the stone
a flood that sweeps the land

The scrolls had all been burned

Keep them in the land of the north

questions.q: What does the LORD say he fills?

Which prophets did the LORD say he was against?
options: Those who each steal his words from his neighbor
Those who refuse to speak at all
Those who prophesy only to kings
Those who write his words on scrolls

The priests who served in the temple
The soldiers who defended the city

Give them the throne of Babylon
Keep them among the Chaldeans forever
